title: Wireframe overlay material
purpose: Build a material that renders every polygon edge as a glowing line over a base surface, with the line width in pixels or metres and an optional fade on surfaces seen edge-on. Use it for technical renders, topology presentations, sci-fi looks and blueprint styles.

parameters.name: surface_color
parameters.description: Colour of the faces between the lines.

parameters.name: line_width
parameters.description: Line width in pixels, or in metres when use_pixel_size is false.

parameters.name: use_pixel_size
parameters.description: Measure the line width in pixels on screen instead of metres on the surface.

parameters.name: fade_grazing
parameters.description: How much lines fade on surfaces seen edge-on.

parameters.name: assign
parameters.description: Assign the material to the active object.

outputs.description: One material with a node tree; assigned to the active object.

limits: Relies on the Wireframe shader node, which Cycles renders; EEVEE does not support it and shows the base surface only. Edges come from the triangulated render mesh, so n-gons show their internal triangulation. Lines are emissive and do not cast shadows. Rendered here with Cycles CPU only. Verified in Blender 5.2.1; written for the 4.2 API.
technique_references: Wireframe shader node in pixel or world size
Facing term to fade lines at grazing angles
Mix of a surface and an emission
